title: Set 233

sentences.ko: 맥스네 반 담임이 학년 중간에 바뀐대, 들었어? 이제 겨우 학교를 좋아하기 시작했는데, 또 마음을 닫아 버릴까 봐 좀 걱정돼.
sentences.text: Did you hear they're giving Max a new teacher halfway through the year? He finally started liking school, so I'm kind of worried he's going to shut down again.

alts.text: Wait, they're switching Max's teacher in the middle of the year? He was just starting to like school, so I'm kinda scared he's gonna shut down again.
Have you heard that Max will be assigned a new teacher halfway through the year? He had finally begun to enjoy school, so I am somewhat concerned that he will withdraw again.

sentences.note: **halfway through the year** 는 한 해의 중간쯤에, 학년 도중에라는 뜻입니다. **shut down** 은 사람에게 쓰면 마음을 닫고 입을 다문다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 나 이제 그만둘 때가 된 것 같아. 일 자체는 괜찮은데, 매일 아침 출근하는 게 너무 싫어. 지금 안 나가면 5년 뒤에도 거기서 똑같은 소리 하고 있을까 봐 무서워.
sentences.text: I think I'm ready to quit, honestly. I mean, the job itself is fine, but I dread going in every single morning, and if I don't leave now, I'm scared I'll still be there in five years saying the same thing.

alts.text: Honestly, I think I'm done. The job's fine, but I hate going in every single morning, and if I don't get out now, I'm scared I'll still be there in five years saying the same thing.

To be honest, I believe I am ready to resign. The work itself is acceptable, but I dread going in each and every morning, and if I do not leave now, I am afraid I will still be there in five years saying the same thing.

sentences.note: **dread** 는 앞으로 할 일이 몹시 싫고 두렵다는 뜻이고, **every single morning** 은 하루도 빠짐없이 매일 아침을 강조하는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 커피 식는 동안 영상 하나만 보려고 앉았는데, 어쩌다 보니 벌써 열두 시더라. 근데 뭘 봤는지 기억도 안 나. 그게 제일 최악이야.
sentences.text: I only sat down to watch one video while my coffee cooled off, and somehow it was noon. And I don't even remember what I watched, which is the worst part.

alts.text: Sat down for one video while my coffee cooled, and next thing I know it's noon. Worst part? I don't even remember what I watched.
I only sat down to watch one video while my coffee cooled, and before I knew it, it was noon. What is worse, I do not even remember what I watched.

sentences.note: **cooled off** 는 뜨거운 것이 식었다는 뜻이고, **somehow** 는 어떻게 된 건지 모르게, 어쩌다 보니라는 느낌입니다. **which is the worst part** 는 앞 내용을 받아 그게 제일 나쁜 점이라고 덧붙일 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 휴대폰을 안 쓰고 있어도 자꾸 엄청 뜨거워지고, 점심때면 배터리가 다 나가. 지난번 업데이트 때문인지 그냥 오래돼서 그런지 모르겠는데, 안 사도 되면 새로 안 사고 싶어.
sentences.text: My phone keeps getting really hot even when I'm not using it, and the battery's dead by lunch. I can't tell if it's the last update or if it's just old, but I'd rather not buy a new one if I don't have to.

alts.text: Ugh, my phone gets super hot even when I'm not on it, and it's dead by lunch. Could be the last update, could just be old, but I'd rather not buy a new one if I don't have to.

My phone frequently becomes very hot even when I am not using it, and the battery is depleted by lunchtime. I cannot tell whether it is the latest update or simply its age, but I would prefer not to purchase a new one unless it is necessary.

sentences.note: **the battery's dead** 는 배터리가 다 닳았다는 뜻입니다. **I can't tell if** 는 ~인지 아닌지 잘 모르겠다, **I'd rather not** 은 웬만하면 ~하고 싶지 않다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 잘 되긴 하는데, 미리 말해 둘게요. 소리를 너무 키우면 왼쪽 스피커가 가끔 끊겨요. 그래서 40달러만 받는 거예요. 그게 신경 쓰이시면 안 사셔도 괜찮아요.
sentences.text: It works fine, but I should tell you the left speaker cuts out sometimes if you turn it up too loud. That's why I'm only asking forty bucks, so if that bugs you, no hard feelings.

alts.text: Works fine, but heads up, the left speaker cuts out sometimes if you crank it too loud. That's why it's only forty bucks, so if that bugs you, no hard feelings.

It works well, but I should mention that the left speaker occasionally cuts out if the volume is set too high. That is why I am asking only forty dollars, so if that concerns you, I completely understand.

sentences.note: **cuts out** 는 소리나 신호가 잠깐씩 끊긴다는 뜻이고, **bugs you** 는 거슬리게 한다는 뜻입니다. **no hard feelings** 는 서운해하지 않으니 괜찮다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

reviewed: 3번 한국어 '제일 웃겨'가 영어 which is the worst part 와 뜻이 다름. '그게 제일 최악이야'로 맞춤
3번 formal 'somehow it became noon'은 원어민이 안 쓰는 말이라 'before I knew it, it was noon'으로 고침
2번 formal에서 every single 의 강조가 빠져서 'each and every morning'으로 살림
